a nilmanifold admits a calibrated G_ 2-structure if and only if the Lie algebra of its fundamental group is isomorphic to a direct product of Lie algebras of type A, B, D, G 2 or Spin(7), with the Lie algebras A, B and D being abelian, and the Lie algeba G 2 being a direct sum of copies of the Lie algebra g 2.

the existence of a Lie algebra epinorphism from a Lie algebra g with a calibrated G2-structure to a six dimensional Lie algebra h with symplectic form implies that g has a calibrated G2 structure, except in the case where the six-dimensional Lie algebra is a nilpotent Lie algebra of type (1,1,1,0,0,0) or (0,0,1,1) or (0) or (1,0,1).

the existence of a G2-calibrated structure in a nilmanifold is equivalent to the nilmanifold being a principal torus bundle over the 6-dimensional nilmanifold with the symplectic form, and the G2-calibrated form is the pull-back of the symplectic structure by the projection.
